content:
samira (Finance): Quick note: we're changing how short-term rate-limit smoothing is billed. Instead of blanket overage caps, we'll introduce a small per-event 'rate_smoothing_fee' for requests that exceed burst thresholds but are within the new smoothing window.

neal (Product): TL;DR: smoothing window = 60s, applies to short bursts above org's published qps. If router permits a request in smoothing, it may incur the fee; otherwise old 429 behavior remains. No base rate-limit changes.

yuri (Billing Eng): Implementation: fee emits a discrete invoice line item 'rate_smoothing_fee' with cents-per-event. We'll include opt-out per-org via Billing Settings. Default: ON for new orgs, OFF for existing.

cass (Support): Will customers see surprises on invoices? Need clear sample lines.

samira (Finance): We'll show an in-console pre-bill summary and add a help-center KB with examples and a calculator. Also adding a notification email if smoothing fees exceed $10 in a billing period.

oliver (CEO): For Sales: keep Reserved/Dedicated exemptions in the playbook. This is a self-serve revenue lever, not meant to penalize enterprise customers with contracts.

yuri (Billing Eng): Rollout: feature flag -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 10 days. Watch metrics: smoothing-allow-rate, fee volume, support tickets opened.

billing-bot: deploy started: rate-smoothing:v1.0.0 -> canary 5% (runbook: /runbooks/rate-smoothing)

cass (Support): Draft support blurb: "New: optional rate smoothing that reduces 429s for short bursts. When smoothing is used, a small per-event fee may appear as 'rate_smoothing_fee' on invoices. Opt-out available in Billing Settings."

yuri (Billing Eng): Also: metering-grace remains unchanged for disputes. Smoothing fees are billable and follow standard dispute flow.

samira (Finance): Communication plan: KB + console banner + 30/14/7 day emails for existing orgs before we flip default. Will run a 2-week internal pilot.

billing-bot: deploy success: rate-smoothing:v1.0.0 canary healthy (2026-04-02T14:23:11Z)

neal (Product): If you want to join the internal pilot, DM me. :rocket:
